newsitem.title: USA: Bowater sets sale of Star Forms unit.
newsitem.headline: Bowater sets sale of Star Forms unit.

text.p: Bowater Inc said Monday it agreed to sell its converting business known as Star Forms Inc -- formerly Bowater Communications Papers Inc -- to CST Office Products Inc for about $80 million, including $60 million in cash and $20 million in notes.
Bowater said it anticipates reporting a gain, which will be determined upon completion of the sale.
It said the transaction is expected to be finalized in the fourth quarter, subject to certain conditions.
Star Forms, which operates five converting plants, is a producer and marketer of continuous stock computer forms.
CST Office Products is a privately held corporation headquartered in Wheeling, Ill., producing a variety of paper products sold throughout North America.
